verdict: Organic presence is holding overall, but local visibility softened this week.
narrative: Across all three locations, your business generated 392 Google Business Profile actions in the last 28 days — all from organic search, with no paid advertising running on any account. Advance Grinding was a bright spot, with profile activity up 52% week over week. Forte Metals and O'Hare Precision both saw profile engagement pull back sharply in the final days of the period, with Forte down 63% and O'Hare down 32% week over week — and search clicks declining in tandem at O'Hare, pointing to a visibility issue rather than seasonal softening alone. We're reviewing all three profiles for listing quality and search signals this week to stabilize the dip before it carries into next period.
